changelog:
Initial release of process-keeper skill.

- Enables backfilling project timelines and capturing key decisions, fixes, and lessons.
- Extracts reusable process notes and article-ready material from development work.
- Keeps process logs compact and organized, avoiding excess detail.
- Supports workflows with HISTORY.md (timeline), PROCESS_GUIDE.md (rules), and TEMPLATE.md (entry structure).
- Designed for use with various repo-aware and editor-integrated coding assistants.
summary: Backfill development history and keep compact process logs
